findings.F1: In the falling, agitated profile, the size of an up day does not grade the next day. The next-day excess return by rise quintile runs -1.60 %, -0.60 %, -1.57 %, -0.80 %, -0.32 % for mean rises of 0.44 % to 11.25 %. The Spearman correlation of rise and next-day excess is 0.01 (p 0.79), and the day-clustered slope on the rise is 0.061 (t 0.79, 613 cases, 258 days). The test's slope t of 0.25 is therefore a missing gradient, not a weak one.
findings.F2: Up days in the profile are followed by a fall on average: the mean next-day excess return is -0.98 % (t -4.23, 613 cases). The fall is on the same side for every coin (BTC -1.08 %, ETH -0.85 %, LTC -1.07 %, XMR -1.10 %, XRP -0.54 %, ZEC -1.08 %), but it is flat across sizes, and the largest rises show the smallest fall (-0.32 %, t -0.45).
findings.F3: The mirror side carries the graded reversal the brief describes. On down days in the profile, the next-day excess return by fall quintile runs from +3.49 % (t 4.99) for the largest falls to +1.13 %, +1.12 %, +0.60 % and -0.06 % for the smallest. The day-clustered slope of next-day excess on the day's return is -0.394 (t -4.10, 675 cases, 289 days), and on the standardised fall it is -0.0106 (t -3.76).
findings.F4: The graded rebound after falls holds coin by coin and year by year. The slope is negative for all six coins (BTC t -3.78, ETH -2.98, LTC -2.64, XMR -2.45, ZEC -2.61, XRP -1.30) and in all four years (2018 -0.18, 2019 -0.23, 2020 -0.45, 2021 -0.50).
findings.F5: The rebound after falls is spent within the next day. The day-after-next slope on the standardised fall is +0.0046 (t 1.95), a slight giveback rather than a continuation. The largest-fall quintile's next-day rebound of +3.49 % is about 18 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade.

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a coin's one-day percent fall, the larger its rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: In a falling, agitated market, a trader can buy a coin after a sharp down day, sized by the fall, and hold it for one day, because forced selling's discount is repaid the next day.
ideas.name: falling-agitated daily fall rebound
